'''Omega's ship'''<ref name="Cavalry AD" /> was a [[starship]] used by the [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. She kept it docked in a [[cave]] next to [[Pabu cove]]. Omega eventually left [[Pabu island|Pabu]] in the ship to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], accompanied by the [[GNK-series power droid]] [[Gonky (Clone Force 99)|Gonky]].<ref name="Cavalry" />

The ship's boarding ramp was located on the port side of the ship. The ship had a dorsal fin and two squat wings that folded slightly out upon takeoff. There were several mementos of Omega's squad, [[Clone Force 99]], incorporated inside. [[Tech's goggles]] were positioned in the cockpit, and the [[tooka doll]] [[Lula]] sat in the cabin.<ref name="Cavalry" />
